name: strong_specific
description: Answers every anchor with a concrete instance and every probe with mechanism and ownership. Hints say the required elements are present.

turns.say: At Acme I repair rooftop HVAC units for commercial sites across West Yorkshire. I've been there since March 2023, and I do about twelve call-outs a week, every one logged in the CMMS.
March 2023, and yes, repair work is still most of my week. Last quarter I closed 41 of my 46 call-outs on the first visit.
Last month I traced a recurring compressor trip across 6 rooftop units from scratch using the CMMS history and a leak detector, and wrote a three-step repair plan. It cleared five of the six.
I started with the units that had tripped in the last 60 days, because that pointed to a shared cause, and I ruled out anything under 5 years old because those were still under the maker's warranty.
The diagnosis and the repair plan were mine. My supervisor signed off the first parts order but the fault-finding and the fixes were my calls.
I want to work on hospital plant rooms specifically, and this role is repair work on commercial sites on your own route, which is exactly what I have been doing.
Diagnosing faults from scratch, running my own route without a supervisor on site, and owning the first visit.
